response.answer:

For the 1st stage of the CO2 compressor operating under rated conditions, the expected polytropic efficiency is 82% at a suction capacity of 36,962.0 m³/hr [Doc 1, p. 5]. The performance curve for the rated 1st stage shows that the vertical "Rated" line, corresponding to the specified suction capacity, intersects the efficiency curve at 82% [Doc 1, p. 5].

response.answer:
The specified rated operating conditions for the 4th stage of the CO2 compressor are a suction pressure of 79.5 BAR. A and a suction temperature of 50.0 DEG. C [Doc 2, p.10], [Doc 6, p.11]. The molecular weight for the 4th stage is not clearly specified in the provided documents.

*   **Inlet Pressure:** 79. 5 BAR. A [Doc 2, p.10] / 79. 5 BARA [Doc 6, p.11]
*   **Inlet Temperature:** 50. 0 DEG. C [Doc 2, p.10], [Doc 6, p.11]. A note also states that the "Suction temp. of 4th stage must never drop below 50℃" [Doc 3, p.1].
*   **Molecular Weight:** Not specified. One performance curve for the 4th stage shows a garbled value ("res 40 Ty") [Doc 2, p.10], while another leaves the value blank [Doc 6, p.11].
